# Cached data for Quran 1:7

## Arabic (Uthmani)
صِرَٰطَ ٱلَّذِينَ أَنْعَمْتَ عَلَيْهِمْ غَيْرِ ٱلْمَغْضُوبِ عَلَيْهِمْ وَلَا ٱلضَّآلِّينَ

## Khattab — The Clear Quran
"the Path of those You have blessed—not those You are displeased with, or those who are astray."

## Word-by-word
1. صِرَٰطَ | ṣirāṭa | (The) path
2. ٱلَّذِينَ | alladhīna | (of) those
3. أَنْعَمْتَ | anʿamta | You have blessed / bestowed favor
4. عَلَيْهِمْ | ʿalayhim | upon them
5. غَيْرِ | ghayri | not (of)
6. ٱلْمَغْضُوبِ | l-maghḍūbi | those who earned (Your) wrath
7. عَلَيْهِمْ | ʿalayhim | upon themselves
8. وَلَا | walā | and not
9. ٱلضَّآلِّينَ | l-ḍālīna | (of) those who go astray

## Note for the agent
There is a famous prophetic interpretation linking ٱلْمَغْضُوبِ عَلَيْهِمْ (those upon whom is wrath) and ٱلضَّآلِّينَ (those who go astray) to specific historical communities. The hadith is in Tirmidhi (#2954, graded Hasan) — verify on sunnah.com before citing. The tafseer should treat this carefully: the categories are *moral types* (those who knew and disobeyed; those who acted without knowledge) more than ethnic markers — this is the dominant mainstream classical and contemporary reading.
